summary: High Templar Tech Ltd, a NYSE-listed Chinese foreign private issuer formerly Qudian, furnished a Form 6-K containing an earnings release for the first half of 2026. Revenues fell 72.7% to RMB8.0 million on the complete wind-down of the last-mile delivery business, while net income attributable to shareholders was RMB416.9 million, or RMB2.64 per diluted ADS, driven by RMB1.28 billion of net interest and investment income. No transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms were disclosed; the filing is a routine results announcement, not a special situation.
